findings.title: Historical Shadow Calls count lacks an as-of date
findings.what: The redesign rationale cites a concrete historical dataset state—26 counted experiments versus 43 ledger lines, including 15 synthetic rows and 2 skipped rows—but says only that this happened "once." Without an as-of date or artifact reference, the example is not reproducible and cannot be distinguished from current baseline state.
findings.fix: Add the observation date and the exact ledger or fixture artifact/ref used for the 26/43 comparison, while retaining explicitly historical wording.
findings.acceptance: The paragraph names an ISO date and a reproducible baseline artifact/ref for the 43-line ledger; a reviewer can recover 26 included, 15 synthetic, and 2 skipped records from that reference.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read docs/product/features/shadow-calls.md:8-16 and :31-43 at the immutable baseline. The arithmetic reconciles (26 + 15 + 2 = 43), and the page correctly frames the event as historical, but neither cited passage supplies an asOf date or reproducible artifact reference; no comparison-only file was used.
